design_note: GRAVE V5 FRAME-01. User requested skeleton design and standalone approval prior to armor installation. V4 armor entirely omitted from this production model; V4 preserved in commit bb4f6577d108a89786c01fe5e38f25d52203e6e2. Structural concept: twin open longitudinal trusses, hollow neck yoke, upper/rear bridges, angular jaw fork, optical bridge with real aperture, one recessed lens, flanged side bearings, rear controller, eight attachment pads. Dimensions inferred from previous model envelope, not certified rig dimensions. Armor fitting only after visual/technical review of the skeleton; no claim of structural or collision validation. Knowledge 2026-11-27-07-modeling and 2026-11-27-12-modeling: corresponding loop vertices, closed wall geometry, intended contacts distinguished from interference. No new external research.
